stories.title: More than 81,000 Ameren Missouri customers remain without power Friday morning after Thanksgiving snowstorm
stories.summary: Ameren said restoration could take multiple days as hundreds of additional workers arrive from across the Midwest to assist with repairs.

stories.title: Missouri officials warn shoppers of holiday scams ahead of Black Friday
stories.summary: Missouri officials and the Better Business Bureau urge holiday shoppers to beware of fake websites, fraudulent QR codes and gift card scams.

stories.title: St. Louis firefighter injured after being struck by vehicle in Dutchtown
stories.summary: A St. Louis firefighter is recovering after suffering serious injuries when a vehicle struck them at a house fire. A 27-year-old man was arrested.

stories.title: St. Louis community Thanksgiving dinners serve more people after power outages
stories.summary: House of Soul and Pride St. Louis welcomed more people than usual for free Thanksgiving meals as power outages disrupted holiday plans.

stories.title: Heavy snow causes 'catastrophic' damage at World Bird Sanctuary
stories.summary: Heavy, wet snow damaged 12 aviaries at the World Bird Sanctuary in Valley Park. No birds were injured, but repairs were expected to take months.

stories.title: Record-breaking snowfall confirmed in St. Louis region, National Weather Service says
stories.summary: The National Weather Service said it's the most snow they've ever received during this time of year.

stories.title: St. Louis' Thanksgiving snowfall totals released
stories.summary: Here's how much snow has already fallen on St. Louis communities as rain enters the region.

stories.title: Snow blankets roads across St. Louis. Check live road conditions here.
stories.summary: Drivers in St. Louis and surrounding areas can check real-time road conditions during the snowstorm using MoDOT and IDOT maps.

stories.title: LIVE RADAR: Snow moves into St. Louis as Thanksgiving travel ramps up
stories.summary: While some communities will see more than 6" of snow, including the metro area, the impacts are far different than a frigid cold snowstorm. Watch them roll in here.

stories.title: Parkway Central student to perform in 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade
stories.summary: Sarah Taylor, a sophomore, plays the alto saxophone and was selected for the honor band, which is composed of top high school musicians from all 50 states.

stories.title: Man's death at St. Louis' City Justice Center triggers police investigation
stories.summary: The male detainee was transported to an area hospital Wednesday morning, where he was pronounced dead, according to the mayor's office.

stories.title: 'We are prepared for this storm': MoDOT fully staffed ahead of first winter storm
stories.summary: MoDOT's primary message for drivers is to get your errands done early Wednesday and stay off the roads as long as you can Thursday morning.
